items.title: Permian Natural Gas Cash Rebounds as Cooler Outlook Weighs on Broader Market
items.summary: Natural gas cash prices weakened across much of the country Wednesday as traders looked toward cooler conditions across the South Central United States, but a sharp Permian Basin rebound and persistent Southeast premiums bucked the broader trend.

items.title: $3 Rebuff Sends Natural Gas Futures Sliding
items.summary: Natural gas futures extended their retreat Wednesday as fading power demand and the approach of milder fall temperatures pressured the market despite strong LNG feedgas and expectations for a relatively lean storage injection Thursday.

items.title: El Niño Risk Looms as Europe’s Natural Gas Storage Refill Runs Behind Pace
items.summary: Warmer forecast shifts across both Europe and Asia have tightened the margin between natural gas futures in both basins as thin European storage and Middle East supply risk keep the pull on Gulf Coast cargoes tight.

items.title: EIA Says Natural Gas Prices to Climb Modestly in Late 2026, Early 2027
items.summary: Average benchmark natural gas spot prices are poised to rise late in 2026, according to an updated federal forecast, though strong production and plump storage could keep increases moderate in the near term and during the coming winter.

items.title: Technical Indicators Mixed as Natural Gas Dips Below Ascending Channel
items.summary: October Henry Hub natural gas futures probed below a key technical support level on Wednesday while spot prices trended even lower, potentially signaling more weakness for the prompt month.

items.title: Natural Gas Prices Weaken Intraday as Supply Counters Seasonal Demand Strength
items.summary: New York Mercantile Exchange natural gas futures grappled with bearish headwinds at midday Wednesday as traders weighed solid near-term demand against forecasts for milder fall weather ahead and stout supply.

items.title: ‘Best Market’ for Appalachian Natural Gas ‘Is In-Basin,’ as Pipeline Bottlenecks Persist
items.summary: The Appalachian natural gas industry is undergoing a structural shift, pivoting from a scramble for production growth to a strategy focused on local demand.

items.title: Struggling Natural Gas Futures Testing Support as Shoulder Season Looms
items.summary: Prompt month natural gas futures edged downward in early Wednesday trade as a waning demand outlook for late September outweighed strong immediate-term cooling and LNG export needs.

items.title: Western Heat Ignites Natural Gas Cash as Prices Soar
items.summary: Spot natural gas prices strengthened across much of the country Tuesday, with gains spreading from the Permian Basin and Rockies into Appalachia and the Northeast. Meanwhile, elevated Gulf Coast and Southeast prices reversed course.
